notes: Hudhayl tells a story: the man, Abu Musa and Salman who answer him, and the man who goes on to Ibn Mas'ud are scene figures, not links.
The last link is the speaker of the ruling «ولكني سأقضي بما قضى به رسول الله», taken as written: «فقال عبد الله».
«وكيع» is a name (Wakiʿ), not the conjunction.
